clips.title: The story
paras: In southwestern Hillsbrad, Azurelode Mine sends iron to the Alliance war effort. Southshore's militia guards the human laborers who work its tunnels.

Southwest of the open farmland and just west of Southshore, Azurelode Mine cuts into the ridges along the coast. Human miners work deep underground under Foreman Bonds's watch, drawing iron for arms and armor. That iron helps Alliance defenders hold the region against the Undercity.

Southshore's garrisons and town militia rely on Azurelode Mine for most of their raw iron. Tarren Mill targets the mine's workers and guards, seeking to break the supply lines that sustain Hillsbrad's human strongholds.
